title: Behind the Wall: The Church in Eastern Germany
author: Garold and Norma Davis

footnotes.text: Garold and Norma Davis served as missionaries in Dresden, German Democratic Republic. Brother Davis is a professor of German and chair of the Department of Germanic and Slavic Languages at Brigham Young University, Provo, Utah, where Sister Davis is an assistant professor of humanities. They live in the Oak Hills Second Ward, Provo Utah Oak Hills Stake.
